user.title: Superloop authentication
user.description: Choose your account authentication method. The current Superloop App 2.0 OTP flow is not yet supported directly.

password.title: Legacy email and password
password.description: Use this only if your Superloop account still has a password.

existing_token.title: Existing access token (experimental)
existing_token.description: Paste an access token obtained from your own Superloop session. Home Assistant checks whether it can access the original Superloop services API. This is a diagnostic workaround, not automatic email/postcode/OTP login. Keep the token private.

2fa.title: Legacy two-factor authentication
2fa.description: Enter the verification code received for the legacy account.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Superloop. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired credentials or token
error.incompatible_api: The token was not accepted by the original Superloop services API. This token may belong to the new App 2.0 system.

abort.already_configured: This Superloop account is already configured
